[ARTICLE] How To Train Your Pet For The Next Big Game
If you’re like most people, then chances are that when it comes time for sports season or any other major event in which pets may be involved (such as Halloween), there’s always some sort of training required beforehand so they can participate safely without causing too much trouble! This article will provide tips from experts who know what works best – whether its teaching them how not get into fights with eachother during playtime outside; learning commands such as “sit”,”stay”, etc.; even just getting used being around lots more noise than usual while still keeping calm under pressure!
The first step is finding out if your furry friend has been trained before.
It might seem obvious but many owners don’t realize this until after their pup starts barking at strangers passing by every day because he thinks everyone wants attention all over again… And we’ve seen plenty examples where dogs were taught NOT TO BARK AT STRANGERS ONLY FOR THEMSELVES AND THEIR OWN GOOD REASONS TOO!! So make sure YOU KNOW WHAT KIND OF TRAINING YOUR PET HAS HAD IN THE PAST BEFORE STARTING ANY NEW ONES!!
Next up: What kind? There are two main types available today depending upon personal preference:
Positive reinforcement involves rewarding good behavior through treats given immediately following desired actions taken correctly whereas negative punishment means taking away something bad happening right now instead e.g., scolding someone verbally rather than physically hitting him/her directly onto face/head area(s).
Finally let me tell ya about one last thing called classical conditioning wherein certain stimuli become associated together overtime leading eventually towards automatic responses whenever those particular things happen simultaneously within environment surrounding us humans alike animals included naturally enough 🙂
